meta.en: Era: Active c. 1880s–1924; Headman of Chikoneni from 1920 (birth and death dates unknown)
meta.sw: Kipindi: Alikuwa hai takriban miaka ya 1880–1924; Mkuu wa Lokesheni wa Chikoneni kuanzia 1920 (tarehe za kuzaliwa na kufa kwake hazijulikani)
meta.dg: Wakati: Kala anahenda kazize kama miaka ya 1880 hadi 1924; Dzumbe wa Chikoneni kula 1920 (taimanyikana ariphovyalwa wala ariphofwa)

meta.en: Role: Early Muslim convert and trader; builder of the first mosque at Chikoneni; colonial Headman of Chikoneni location and President of the Digo Central Council
meta.sw: Jukumu: Mmoja wa Waislamu wa mwanzo na mfanyabiashara; mjenzi wa msikiti wa kwanza wa Chikoneni; Mkuu wa kikoloni wa eneo la Chikoneni na Rais wa Baraza Kuu la Adigo
meta.dg: Kazi: Mmwenga wa Aislamu a kpwandza na mchuuzi; wadzenga msikiti wa kpwandza wa Chikoneni; Dzumbe wa chikoloni wa lalo ra Chikoneni na Rais wa Baraza Kulu ra Adigo

meta.en: Region: Chikoneni, in the south of present-day Kwale County, Kenya (then Vanga District, renamed Digo District in 1924)
meta.sw: Eneo: Chikoneni, kusini mwa Kaunti ya Kwale ya leo, Kenya (wakati huo Wilaya ya Vanga, iliyobadilishwa jina kuwa Wilaya ya Digo mwaka 1924)
meta.dg: Phatu: Chikoneni, kusini mwa Kaunti ya Kwale ya rero, Kenya (wakati hinyo kala ni Wilaya ya Vanga, ambayo mwaka 1924 yaihwa Wilaya ya Digo)

blocks.en: For most of the nineteenth century Chikoneni, some forty miles south of Mombasa, stood well apart from the Muslim towns of the coast. By the 1920s it had mosques and Qur'an schools, and its leading man was a Muslim trader whom British officers called "one of the most energetic and intelligent Presidents in the District". That man was Muhammad Masemo.
blocks.sw: Kwa sehemu kubwa ya karne ya kumi na tisa, Chikoneni, iliyo kama maili arobaini kusini mwa Mombasa, ilikuwa mbali kabisa na miji ya Kiislamu ya pwani. Kufikia miaka ya 1920 ilikuwa na misikiti na vyuo vya Qurani, na mtu wake mkuu alikuwa mfanyabiashara Mwislamu ambaye maafisa wa Kiingereza walimwita "mmoja wa Marais wenye bidii na akili zaidi katika Wilaya". Mtu huyo alikuwa Muhammad Masemo.
blocks.dg: Kpwa sehemu kulu ya karne ya kumi na tisa, Chikoneni, iriyo kama maili arubaini kusini mwa Mombasa, kala i kure sana na midzi ya Chiislamu ya pwani. Kufikira miaka ya 1920 kala ina misikiti na vyuo vya Kuruani, na mutu mkpwulu iko kala ni mchuuzi Mwislamu ambaye maafisa a Chingereza amuiha "mmwenga wa marais enye bidii na akili kuriko osi kpwenye Wilaya". Mutu hiye kala ni Muhammad Masemo.

blocks.en: His story survives in the memories of his son, Omari Muhammad Masemo, whom the historian David Sperling interviewed in 1975 and 1976, and in colonial files Sperling found in the Kenya National Archives. This article follows Sperling's account.
blocks.sw: Habari zake zimehifadhiwa katika kumbukumbu za mwanawe, Omari Muhammad Masemo, ambaye mwanahistoria David Sperling alimhoji mwaka 1975 na 1976, na katika mafaili ya kikoloni ambayo Sperling aliyapata katika Hifadhi ya Kitaifa ya Kenya. Makala hii inafuata simulizi la Sperling.
blocks.dg: Habarize zinaphahikana kpwa mambo ambago mwanawe, Omari Muhammad Masemo, wagatambukira, ambaye mwanahistoria David Sperling wamuuza maswali mwaka 1975 na 1976, na kpwa mafaili ga chikoloni ambago Sperling wagaphaha kpwenye Hifadhi ya Taifa ya Kenya. Makala ihi inalunga maelezo ga Sperling.

blocks.en: The southern Digo had an unusually centralised form of rule. At the end of the eighteenth century Mbogo Mwamzungu, a newcomer to kaya Dzombo, became their dominant leader and took the name *Kubo*. A *kaya* is a fortified village in a forest clearing, and the sacred forest that remains where it stood. Mwamzungu's successors kept Kubo as a title. The Kubos had close ties with the Muslim Diwans of Vanga, but none of them is known to have practised Islam until Kubo Shehe Mwatsolozi. He was installed in 1895 and died in February 1916.
blocks.sw: Adigo wa kusini walikuwa na mfumo wa utawala uliokusanywa mkononi mwa kiongozi mmoja kwa namna isiyo ya kawaida. Mwishoni mwa karne ya kumi na nane Mbogo Mwamzungu, mgeni aliyefika Kaya Dzombo, akawa kiongozi wao mkuu na akachukua jina *Kubo*. *Kaya* ni kijiji chenye ngome kilichojengwa katika uwazi ndani ya msitu, na pia ni msitu mtakatifu unaobaki pale kilipokuwa. Waliomrithi Mwamzungu waliendeleza Kubo kama cheo. Akina Kubo walikuwa na uhusiano wa karibu na Madiwani Waislamu wa Vanga, lakini hakuna hata mmoja wao anayejulikana kuwa alifuata Uislamu hadi Kubo Shehe Mwatsolozi. Yeye alisimikwa mwaka 1895 na akafariki Februari 1916.
blocks.dg: Adigo a kusini kala ana utawala ambao, kuriko kawaida, mamlaka gosi kala ganakala mkpwononi mwa chilongozi mmwenga. Mwisho wa karne ya kumi na nane Mbogo Mwamzungu, mjeni ariyefika Kaya Dzombo, wakala chilongozi wao mkpwulu na wahala dzina *Kubo*. *Kaya* ni chidzidzi chenye ngome chirichodzengbwa phatu pha wazi kahi ya tsaka, na piya ni tsaka takatifu ririrobaki phatu phara chidzidzi chiriphokala. Atu ariorisi utawala wa Mwamzungu achienderera kuhumira Kubo dza cheo. Akina Kubo kala ana uhusiano wa phephi na Madiwani Aislamu a Vanga, ela takuna hata mmwenga wao anayemanyikana kukala walunga dini ya Chiislamu hadi Kubo Shehe Mwatsolozi. Iye waikpwa kukala Kubo mwaka 1895, na wafwa Februari 1916.

blocks.en: After Shehe's death six men claimed the title. The war delayed a decision, and the British appointed one of the claimants, Fundi Mwabege, as Headman of Chikoneni instead. The title Kubo then fell out of use.
blocks.sw: Baada ya kifo cha Shehe, wanaume sita walidai cheo hicho. Vita vilichelewesha uamuzi, na badala yake Waingereza wakamteua mmoja wa wadai, Fundi Mwabege, kuwa Mkuu wa Chikoneni. Cheo cha Kubo kikaacha kutumika.
blocks.dg: Bada ya chifo cha Shehe, alume sita adai cheo hicho. Viha vyahenda uamuzi ukawie, na Aingereza amtsambula mmwenga wa arioadai, Fundi Mwabege, kukala Dzumbe wa Chikoneni badala ya kuika Kubo. Dzina ra Kubo phahi richiricha kuhumirwa.

blocks.en: Masemo became a Muslim in the 1880s. A healer from Mombasa passing through the area converted him and his wife. Masemo took the name Muhammad, after the healer, and his wife took the name Mwanaisha. The first Digo convert from Chikoneni had been Mwalimu Mnena, converted at Mombasa in the 1870s or 1880s. *Mwalimu* means teacher, and Mnena taught the rudiments of the faith to his friends.
blocks.sw: Masemo aliingia Uislamu katika miaka ya 1880. Mganga kutoka Mombasa aliyekuwa akipita eneo hilo alimsilimisha yeye na mkewe. Masemo alichukua jina Muhammad, kwa jina la mganga huyo, na mkewe akachukua jina Mwanaisha. Mdigo wa kwanza wa Chikoneni kusilimu alikuwa Mwalimu Mnena, aliyesilimu Mombasa katika miaka ya 1870 au 1880. *Mwalimu* maana yake ni mtu anayefundisha, na Mnena aliwafundisha rafiki zake misingi ya dini.
blocks.dg: Masemo wasilimu miaka ya 1880. Mgbwanga mmwenga kula Mombasa, ariyekala anatsupa phara, wamsilimisha iye na mchewe. Masemo wahala dzina Muhammad, dzina ra hiye mgbwanga, na mchewe wahala dzina Mwanaisha. Mdigo wa kpwandza wa Chikoneni kusilimu kala ni Mwalimu Mnena, ariyesilimu Mombasa miaka ya 1870 au 1880. *Mwalimu* manage ni mutu anayefundza, na Mnena wafundza asenae misingi ya dini.

blocks.en: In the 1890s Masemo began tapping rubber with his father-in-law, Muhammad Mwamvini, another early convert. Through the rubber trade he became the purchasing agent and friend of Mwalimu Mbulushi bin Fakir, a Baluchi trader at Chikoneni. He also carried goods to Mombasa himself, a journey of two days. His son remembered that they slept at Tiwi, at the home of his father's friend Mwinyi Haji wa Bwika, and left "at the first crowing of the cock" to reach Mombasa by morning.
blocks.sw: Katika miaka ya 1890 Masemo alianza kugema mpira pamoja na baba mkwe wake, Muhammad Mwamvini, ambaye pia alikuwa mmoja wa Waislamu wa mwanzo. Kupitia biashara ya mpira akawa wakala wa ununuzi na rafiki wa Mwalimu Mbulushi bin Fakir, mfanyabiashara Mbaluchi aliyekuwa Chikoneni. Pia yeye mwenyewe alibeba bidhaa hadi Mombasa, safari ya siku mbili. Mwanawe alikumbuka kwamba walilala Tiwi, nyumbani kwa rafiki wa baba yake, Mwinyi Haji wa Bwika, na wakaondoka "jogoo alipowika mara ya kwanza" ili wafike Mombasa asubuhi.
blocks.dg: Miaka ya 1890 Masemo waandza kujema mpira phamwenga na mtsedzawe, Muhammad Mwamvini, ambaye piya kala ni mmwenga wa Aislamu a kpwandza. Kpwa biashara ya mpira wakala mutu wa kumgulira mpira na msena wa Mwalimu Mbulushi bin Fakir, mchuuzi Mbaluchi wa Chikoneni. Piya iye mwenye kala anatsukula mizigo hadi Mombasa, charo cha siku mbiri. Mwanawe watambukira kukala alala Tiwi, kpwa msena wa ise, Mwinyi Haji wa Bwika, achiuka "wakati wa dzogolo kuika mara ya kpwandza" ili afike Mombasa ligundzu.

blocks.en: Around 1905 Masemo opened his own shop. Sperling says he was the first Digo to trade in clothes at Chikoneni.
blocks.sw: Karibu mwaka 1905 Masemo alifungua duka lake mwenyewe. Sperling anasema alikuwa Mdigo wa kwanza kufanya biashara ya nguo Chikoneni.
blocks.dg: Kama mwaka 1905 Masemo wavugula dukare mwenye. Sperling anaamba kukala iye ndiye kala Mdigo wa kpwandza kuhenda biashara ya nguwo Chikoneni.

blocks.en: Around 1906 Masemo built the Mophe Mosque at his homestead, the first mosque in the Chikoneni area. Before it, Chikoneni's Muslims prayed on mats in the open air. Masemo's son Omari studied under Abdallah bin Kasim Mwangumi, a Segeju teacher who had come to Chikoneni around 1903. When Omari finished, he became the Imam. People came to Friday prayers from Nyamala, Vivwini, Mwaluvanga and Mrima. The mosque collapsed during the First World War. After the war Masemo moved to Chikoneni centre and rebuilt it near his new home.
blocks.sw: Karibu mwaka 1906 Masemo alijenga Msikiti wa Mophe nyumbani kwake, msikiti wa kwanza katika eneo la Chikoneni. Kabla yake, Waislamu wa Chikoneni waliswali juu ya mikeka nje, chini ya anga. Omari, mwana wa Masemo, alisoma kwa Abdallah bin Kasim Mwangumi, mwalimu Msegeju aliyefika Chikoneni karibu mwaka 1903. Omari alipohitimu akawa Imamu. Watu walikuja kwa swala ya Ijumaa kutoka Nyamala, Vivwini, Mwaluvanga na Mrima. Msikiti ulibomoka wakati wa Vita vya Kwanza vya Dunia. Baada ya vita Masemo alihamia katikati ya Chikoneni na akaujenga upya karibu na makazi yake mapya.
blocks.dg: Kama mwaka 1906 Masemo wadzenga Msikiti wa Mophe kpwakpwe kaya, msikiti wa kpwandza kahi ya phatu pha Chikoneni. Kabla ya msikiti uhu, Aislamu a Chikoneni kala anaswali dzulu ya micheka kondze kpwereru. Omari, mwana wa Masemo, wasoma kpwa Abdallah bin Kasim Mwangumi, mwalimu Msegeju ariyefika Chikoneni kama mwaka 1903. Omari ariphomala masomoge, wakala Imamu. Atu kala anakpwedza Swala ya Ijumaa kula Nyamala, Vivwini, Mwaluvanga na Mrima. Msikiti wagbwa wakati wa Viha vya Kpwandza vya Dunia. Bada ya viha Masemo watsama kuphiya kahi-kahi ya Chikoneni na achiudzenga tsena phephi na nyumbaye nyiphya.

blocks.en: The British governed the Digo through councils of elders, which built on the older *ngambi*, the council that ran each kaya and its villages. After 1916 Masemo was, in Sperling's words, "the real leader of Chikoneni location". A District Commissioner wrote in 1920 that the Chikoneni council was "nominally under Fundi Mwabege of Mrima, who is old, and the active work devolves on Mohammed Mwamasemo".
blocks.sw: Waingereza waliwatawala Adigo kupitia mabaraza ya wazee, yaliyojengwa juu ya *ngambi* ya zamani, baraza lililoendesha mambo ya kila kaya na vijiji vyake. Baada ya 1916 Masemo alikuwa, kwa maneno ya Sperling, "kiongozi halisi wa eneo la Chikoneni". Mkuu wa Wilaya aliandika mwaka 1920 kwamba baraza la Chikoneni "kwa jina liko chini ya Fundi Mwabege wa Mrima, ambaye ni mzee, na kazi halisi inaangukia Mohammed Mwamasemo".
blocks.dg: Aingereza kala anatawala Adigo kpwa kuhumira mabaraza ga azehe, garigodzengbwa dzulu ya *ngambi* ya kare, baraza ra azehe ririrokala rinalongoza mambo ga chila kaya na vidzidzivye. Bada ya 1916 Masemo kala, kpwa maneno ga Sperling, "chilongozi wa kpweli wa lalo ra Chikoneni". Afisa wa Wilaya waandika mwaka 1920 kukala baraza ra Chikoneni "kpwa dzina ri photsi ya Fundi Mwabege wa Mrima, ambaye ni mzehe, na kazi ya kpweli inahendwa ni Mohammed Mwamasemo".

blocks.en: When Mwabege died in 1920, Masemo became Headman of Chikoneni and President of the Digo Central Council. A handing-over report of November 1923 gave the verdict quoted above. In January 1924 he was one of two Digo elders invited to visit the British fleet at Mombasa.
blocks.sw: Mwabege alipofariki mwaka 1920, Masemo akawa Mkuu wa Chikoneni na Rais wa Baraza Kuu la Adigo. Ripoti ya makabidhiano ya Novemba 1923 ilitoa tathmini iliyonukuliwa hapo juu. Mnamo Januari 1924 alikuwa mmoja wa wazee wawili wa Kidigo walioalikwa kutembelea manowari za Kiingereza huko Mombasa.
blocks.dg: Mwabege ariphofwa mwaka 1920, Masemo wakala Dzumbe wa Chikoneni na Rais wa Baraza Kulu ra Adigo. Ripoti ya kukabidhiana kazi ya Novemba 1923 yalavya uamuzi uriogombwa dzulu. Januari 1924 iye kala ni mmwenga wa azehe airi a Chidigo arioalikpwa kunyendekera meli za viha za Aingereza iko Mombasa.

blocks.en: The sharpest question of the day was inheritance. Digo custom passed property through the mother's line, while Islamic law passes it from father to son. In 1924 the District Commissioner sounded out the elders and reported that two-thirds favoured change. On 9 August 1924 he "interviewed Mohamed Mwasemo of Chikoneni and discussed the change of inheritance [law]". The diary records that "Mohamed welcomes the change". In 1928 the Court of Appeal ruled, in a case from Pungu, that Islamic law applied and the estate passed from father to son.
blocks.sw: Suala zito zaidi la wakati huo lilikuwa urithi. Mila za Kidigo zilipitisha mali kupitia ukoo wa mama, ilhali sheria ya Kiislamu inapitisha mali kutoka kwa baba hadi kwa mwana. Mwaka 1924 Mkuu wa Wilaya aliwauliza wazee maoni yao na akaripoti kwamba theluthi mbili walipendelea mabadiliko. Tarehe 9 Agosti 1924 "alimhoji Mohamed Mwasemo wa Chikoneni na kujadili mabadiliko ya [sheria ya] urithi". Shajara inaandika kwamba "Mohamed anayakaribisha mabadiliko". Mwaka 1928 Mahakama ya Rufaa iliamua, katika kesi kutoka Pungu, kwamba sheria ya Kiislamu ndiyo inayotumika na mali ya marehemu ilipita kutoka kwa baba hadi kwa mwana.
blocks.dg: Dzambo kulu ra wakati hinyo kala ni urisi. Mila za Chidigo kala zinatsapiza mali kpwa uphande wa mayo, ela shariya ya Chiislamu inatsapiza mali kula kpwa baba hadi kpwa mwana. Mwaka 1924 Afisa wa Wilaya wauza azehe maoni gao, achiripoti kukala azehe airi kpwa chila ahahu kala analonda mabadiliko. Tarehe 9 Agosti 1924 "wamuuza maswali Mohamed Mwasemo wa Chikoneni na achigomba naye kuhusu kubadilishwa kpwa [shariya ya] urisi". Shajara inaandika kukala "Mohamed anakaribisha mabadiliko". Mwaka 1928 Koti ya Rufaa yaamuwa, kpwa kesi kula Pungu, kukala shariya ya Chiislamu ndiyo inayohumirwa, na mali ya ariyefwa yatsapa kula kpwa baba hadi kpwa mwana.

blocks.en: We do not know when Masemo was born or died, or how long he stayed in office after 1924. Colonial clerks spelt his name "Mwamasemo" and "Mwasemo". Sperling does not describe how the Digo Central Council was made up. He also notes a "newly-established Central Council" of the Digo of the nine villages just south of Mombasa, which in 1924 called itself *Midzichenda*. Whether this was the same body as the council Masemo led is not clear; his presidency is recorded from 1920. Much of the personal detail comes from his son, and a son's memories may be generous.
blocks.sw: Hatujui Masemo alizaliwa lini wala alifariki lini, wala alikaa madarakani kwa muda gani baada ya 1924. Makarani wa kikoloni waliandika jina lake "Mwamasemo" na "Mwasemo". Sperling haelezi Baraza Kuu la Adigo liliundwa vipi. Pia anataja "Baraza Kuu lililoundwa karibuni" la Adigo wa vijiji tisa vilivyo kusini kidogo mwa Mombasa, ambalo mwaka 1924 lilijiita *Midzichenda*. Haijulikani wazi kama hili lilikuwa baraza lile lile aliloliongoza Masemo; urais wake umeandikwa kuanzia 1920. Habari nyingi za maisha yake binafsi zinatoka kwa mwanawe, na kumbukumbu za mwana kuhusu baba yake huenda zikawa za kumsifu kupita kiasi.
blocks.dg: Tahumanya Masemo ariphovyalwa wala ariphofwa, wala wakala na cheo hicho hadi rini bada ya 1924. Makarani a chikoloni aandika dzinare "Mwamasemo" na "Mwasemo". Sperling kaeleza ni ani kala anakala kpwenye Baraza Kulu ra Adigo. Piya anataja "Baraza Kulu ririroandzishwa sambi" ra Adigo a vidzidzi chenda virivyo kusini phephi na Mombasa, ambaro mwaka 1924 kala rinadziiha *Midzichenda*. Taimanyikana wazi kama hiri kala ni baraza riro-riro ambaro Masemo kala anarilongoza; uraisiwe unaonekana kpwenye kumbukumbu kula 1920. Mambo manji ga maishage ganatuluka kpwa mwanawe, na mwana achimtambukira ise anaweza kumtogola kuriko chiasi.

blocks.en: Masemo's life bridges two worlds. He became a Muslim in the time of the Kubo, when Chikoneni was remote from the coast. He went on to trade on the road to Mombasa, build his community's first mosque, educate a son who became its Imam, and lead a council under colonial rule. He used that office to support the changes his faith asked of him. When Sperling wrote in the 1980s, the Chikoneni mosque stood where Masemo had rebuilt it after the war.
blocks.sw: Maisha ya Masemo yanaunganisha dunia mbili. Aliingia Uislamu wakati wa Kubo, Chikoneni ilipokuwa mbali na pwani. Baadaye alifanya biashara katika njia ya kwenda Mombasa, akajenga msikiti wa kwanza wa jamii yake, akamsomesha mwana aliyekuja kuwa Imamu wake, na akaongoza baraza chini ya utawala wa kikoloni. Alitumia nafasi hiyo kuunga mkono mabadiliko ambayo imani yake ilimtaka ayafanye. Sperling alipoandika katika miaka ya 1980, msikiti wa Chikoneni ulisimama pale ambapo Masemo aliujenga upya baada ya vita.
blocks.dg: Maisha ga Masemo ganaunganisha dunia mbiri. Wasilimu wakati wa Akubo, wakati Chikoneni kala i kure na pwani. Bada ya hipho wahenda biashara kpwenye njira ya Mombasa, wadzenga msikiti wa kpwandza wa atue, wasomesa mwana ariyekpwedza kukala Imamu wa msikiti uwo, na walongoza baraza photsi ya utawala wa chikoloni. Wahumira cheo hicho kuterya mabadiliko ambago diniye yamlagiza. Sperling ariphoandika miaka ya 1980, msikiti wa Chikoneni kala bado unaima phara Masemo ariphoudzenga tsena bada ya viha.
